impact.contract: Older source details without sourceId remain readable; delete requires UUID source/passage/version handle. Strict acknowledgement parser binds to expected source and validates invalidation IDs. Missing pending handle is backwards compatible; malformed non-null handle fails hydration closed.
impact.privacy: Explicit source/version confirmation; unresolved admission prevents deletion. Conservatively clear report/run/previous report/events/reading/correction and selected attachment bytes/text because previous report lacks complete dependency identity. Preserve plain composer and consent. Same-source idempotent reply with empty invalidated IDs never restores content. Caller must persist redacted snapshot before DELETE and clear confirmed handle only after durable acknowledgement.
impact.integration: Primary owns API, App generations, required persistence, pending handle hydration, and pause/retry gates. Read-only review identified picker completion and attachment-panel races; communicated to primary for integration.
impact.rollback: Disable new deletion scheduling while retaining pending-handle hydration, redaction, explicit idempotent retry and account guards. Do not restore hidden cached source/report content or silently clear unconfirmed deletion. No dependencies, provider changes or paid calls.
